mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS cartItemId, c.product_id AS productId, p.title AS title, p.images AS images, p.price AS price, p.owner_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS sellerNickname, p.status AS productStatus, p.is_deleted AS productDeleted, c.create_time AS createTime FROM cart_items c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.owner_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id AS cartItemId, c.product_id AS productId, p.title AS title, p.images AS images, p.price AS price, p.owner_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS sellerNickname, p.status AS productStatus, p.is_deleted AS productDeleted, c.create_time AS createTime FROM cart_items c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.owner_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
